steps.en: Officer, having decided not to resend, opens the HST suspension screen
steps.id: Officer yang memutuskan tidak resend membuka layar suspension HST
steps.why_en: The screen exists, but the no-resend decision is not recorded or linked.
steps.why_id: Layarnya ada, tapi keputusan tidak resend tidak dicatat atau ditautkan.

steps.en: Officer searches the ID; OCMS checks it and lists its notices
steps.id: Officer mencari ID; OCMS memeriksa dan menampilkan notice-nya

steps.en: OCMS records the ID as HST with name and address
steps.id: OCMS mencatat ID sebagai HST dengan nama dan alamat

steps.en: Indicator is applied to all outstanding notices of the ID
steps.id: Indicator dipasang ke semua notice outstanding milik ID

steps.en: Officer sees whether the indicator was applied
steps.id: Officer melihat apakah indicator berhasil dipasang
steps.why_en: Failed notices are silently ignored; the officer always sees success.
steps.why_id: Notice yang gagal diabaikan diam-diam; officer selalu melihat sukses.
